name: Birthday Celebration
tagline: Candles, confetti and your best year yet.
description: Celebrate another trip around the sun: birthday candles, confetti showers, balloon garlands, rooftop dinners, picnics, disco balls, champagne sprays, surprise parties and a milestone bouquet. Fun, flattering and ready for the birthday post.
